add_asset_to_watchlist_by_id.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): watchlist maintenance. Private to the account, holds no funds, trivially reversible.

cancel_all_orders.rationale: Cancels every open order at once. No funds move and no new exposure is created, so it is graded below order placement — but it is account-wide and removes protective stops together with entries, which puts it above a single cancel.

cancel_order_by_id.rationale: Cancels one identified order. Nothing is bought, sold, or transferred, and committed exposure can only fall. Governed so an agent signer can rate-limit churn and check that a cancelled protective stop is replaced; a human approver on this path is an availability problem rather than a control.

close_all_positions.rationale: Liquidates the portfolio to cash with market orders. Exposure only falls and nothing leaves the account, so it is graded below order placement — but it realises P&L at whatever the book offers, which a cancel does not.

close_position.rationale: Flattens one symbol with a market order. Risk-reducing and bounded by the existing position, but it realises P&L at the available price rather than merely withdrawing an instruction.

create_locate.rationale: Creates a short-sale locate request. A borrowing commitment with fees, bounded by the requested quantity.

create_watchlist.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): watchlist maintenance. Private to the account, holds no funds, trivially reversible.

delete_watchlist_by_id.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): watchlist maintenance. Private to the account, holds no funds, trivially reversible.

do_not_exercise_options_position.rationale: Instructs the broker not to exercise a held contract. The value at stake is bounded by that one contract, but the instruction is terminal at expiry.

exercise_options_position.rationale: Exercises a held contract, converting it into the underlying and committing the capital assignment requires.

place_crypto_order.rationale: Places a live cryptocurrency order, committing funds at market. Value stays inside the account, but a fill is not recallable.

place_option_order.rationale: Places a single- or multi-leg options order. Graded with the other order-placement operations; an operator who wants a human on the unbounded short-leg case should express that as a policy threshold rather than as a blanket grade.

place_stock_order.rationale: Places a live stock or ETF order that commits funds at market.

remove_asset_from_watchlist_by_id.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): watchlist maintenance. Private to the account, holds no funds, trivially reversible.

replace_order_by_id.rationale: Replaces an open order with new parameters. A replacement can raise size or price, so it is graded as placement rather than as a cancel.
